faqs.q: What plans do you have and what do they cost?
faqs.a:
There are two plans, both a one-time platform fee:
• {basic.name}: {basic.price} (regular {basic.regularPrice}). Includes {basic.features}.
• {amazon.name}: {amazon.price} (regular {amazon.regularPrice}). Includes {amazon.features}.

faqs.q: What is in the Basic plan?
faqs.a: The {basic.name} is {basic.price} (regular {basic.regularPrice}), a one-time fee. It includes {basic.features}.

faqs.q: What is in the Amazon plan?
faqs.a: The {amazon.name} is {amazon.price} (regular {amazon.regularPrice}), a one-time fee. It includes {amazon.features}.

faqs.q: Is there any registration fee or monthly subscription?
faqs.a: There's no monthly subscription. You pay a one-time platform access fee ({basic.name} {basic.price} or {amazon.name} {amazon.price}), which also gets you discounted rates. Per-order product, shipping and COD charges apply depending on the order.

faqs.q: What is Sovely Dropshipping and how does it work?
faqs.a: Sovely helps you run an online store without buying or storing stock. You pick products from our catalogue, list them on your store or social channels, and forward customer orders to us. We pack, ship and deliver to your customer with tracking, so you can focus on marketing and sales.

faqs.q: Is Sovely suitable for beginners and small sellers?
faqs.a: Yes. You don't need to buy stock in bulk, run a warehouse or handle packing and shipping. You can start with a few products, test demand and grow from there.

faqs.q: Do I need to buy inventory or maintain stock?
faqs.a: No. You don't buy or store inventory in advance. Products are sourced and fulfilled when your customer orders, so you avoid stock investment and warehouse costs.

faqs.q: How many products can I sell?
faqs.a: You get access to {facts.products} ready-to-sell products across {facts.categories} categories, so you can test different products and expand based on demand.

faqs.q: What product categories are available?
faqs.a: We have {facts.categories} categories, including Health and Beauty, Fashion and Accessories, Home and Kitchen, Electronics and Gadgets, Car Accessories, Fitness, Toys and Games, Travel Accessories, Home Decor and Daily Use products.

faqs.q: How does Sovely help me increase my sales?
faqs.a: You get a wide range of ready-to-sell products, fulfilment support and PAN India delivery, so your time goes into promoting products and finding customers instead of logistics.

faqs.q: Can I see my profit before placing an order?
faqs.a: Yes. Before confirming an order you can work out your profit: your customer's selling price minus the product cost, shipping, COD and any other charges.

faqs.q: How much profit or margin can I earn?
faqs.a: You set your own selling price and keep the difference between that price and the product and fulfilment costs. Sovely's competitive product pricing helps your margin, and you don't spend on inventory or a warehouse. Your exact margin depends on the product and the price you choose.

faqs.q: Can I choose my own selling price?
faqs.a: Yes. You decide your selling price based on your audience, competition and the margin you want. You earn the difference between your price and the product and fulfilment costs.

faqs.q: Do you provide COD (Cash on Delivery)?
faqs.a: Yes, COD is supported, so your customers can pay when the order arrives. The COD charge is {charges.cod} per order, and availability depends on the courier, delivery location and order eligibility.

faqs.q: Who collects COD payments from customers?
faqs.a: The delivery partner collects the cash at delivery. The amount then goes through Sovely's settlement process, and you can track eligible payments and settlements in your portal.

faqs.q: How and when do I get my profit?
faqs.a: Your profit is your selling price minus the product cost, shipping, COD fees, taxes and other charges. After the order is delivered and the payment is reconciled, your earnings are added to your portal wallet, and you can redeem them anytime.

faqs.q: Can I track my orders?
faqs.a: Yes. You can follow every order's processing, dispatch, delivery and return status through the order management and tracking tools, and a same-day tracking ID is supported.

faqs.q: Do you ship to my customers without your branding?
faqs.a: Yes. Orders ship directly to your customers, and we aim for a white-label experience so you can build your own brand.

faqs.q: Who handles packing, shipping and returns?
faqs.a: Sovely handles packing, dispatch and coordination with delivery partners. Eligible returns and RTO shipments follow our return and shipping policies.

faqs.q: How does delivery work and what does it cost?
faqs.a: We deliver PAN India through {facts.couriers} courier partners. Forward delivery is listed at {charges.delivery} flat, though the final shipping charge can depend on weight, courier and location. Delivery timelines vary by location.

faqs.q: How long does it take to dispatch an order?
faqs.a: Dispatch time depends on product availability, order confirmation and warehouse processing, so we can't promise a fixed number of days. Our process is built for timely dispatch.

faqs.q: What are your RTO charges?
faqs.a: RTO (Return to Origin) is when an order can't be delivered and goes back to the warehouse. The listed RTO cost is {charges.rto}, but the actual charge can vary with shipment weight, courier and delivery location.

faqs.q: What happens if a customer refuses the order?
faqs.a: If a customer refuses or isn't available, the courier may raise an NDR (Non-Delivery Report) or start the RTO process. Where possible, a reattempt or address correction can be arranged. Charges may apply.

faqs.q: What if a customer receives a damaged or wrong product?
faqs.a: Raise a return or replacement request through Sovely support. It's reviewed under our product return and replacement policy.

faqs.q: Can I sell through my Shopify store?
faqs.a: Yes. You can list Sovely products on your Shopify store and use our fulfilment. Integration and order sync depend on the available Shopify integration setup.

faqs.q: Can I sell on Instagram, Facebook and WhatsApp?
faqs.a: Yes. You can promote your products on Instagram, Facebook and WhatsApp to bring in customers and enquiries.

faqs.q: Can I sell on Amazon?
faqs.a: Yes. The {amazon.name} ({amazon.price}) covers Amazon account launch, GST registration support, 500+ SEO listings, ads and SEO training, FBA support and a dedicated account manager.

faqs.q: Do I need technical knowledge?
faqs.a: No. You don't need technical skills or ecommerce experience. Sovely simplifies product selection and fulfilment so you can focus on marketing.

faqs.q: Can I sell across India?
faqs.a: Yes. We deliver PAN India through our courier network, subject to serviceability and product availability at your customer's location.

faqs.q: Does Sovely provide support to sellers?
faqs.a: Yes. Our team helps with using the platform, choosing products, fulfilment and day-to-day questions. You can reach them on WhatsApp at {contact.whatsapp}.

faqs.q: Can I scale my business with Sovely?
faqs.a: Yes. Start with a few products and add more as you grow. With {facts.products} products across {facts.categories} categories you can test segments and find winning products without holding stock.

faqs.q: Why choose Sovely over traditional ecommerce?
faqs.a: Traditional ecommerce needs money for stock, storage, packing and shipping. With Sovely you start without bulk inventory, get {facts.products} products across {facts.categories} categories, offer COD where supported, ship PAN India and spend your time on marketing and growth.

faqs.q: How do I sign up or get started?
faqs.a: Fill in the Get Started form on this page and the team will contact you, or message us on WhatsApp at {contact.whatsapp}.
